# apptrust_activity_log (Data Source)

Returns AppTrust activity logs, with optional sorting and filtering. Wraps the `GET /v1/activity/log` API.

## API Notes

- All list-type filters (`application_key`, `project_key`, `application_name`, `project_name`, `subject_type`, `event_type`, `event_category`, `result`, `created_by`) are sent as a single comma-separated query parameter and may match any of the supplied values.
- Pagination is supported via `limit` (default 100, max 10000) and `offset` (default 0).
- Ordering is via `sort_by` (default `timestamp`) and `sort` (`asc`/`desc`, default `desc`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apptrust_activity_log" "example" {
  project_key = ["my-project"]
  result      = ["success"]
  sort_by     = "timestamp"
  sort        = "desc"
  limit       = 50
  offset      = 0
}

output "activity_logs" {
  value = data.apptrust_activity_log.example.activity_logs
}

output "total" {
  value = data.apptrust_activity_log.example.total
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `application_key` (List of String) Filters by application key.
- `application_name` (List of String) Filters by application name.
- `created_by` (List of String) Filters by the user who initiated the event.
- `event_category` (List of String) Filters by event category.
- `event_type` (List of String) Filters by event type.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of logs to return. API default is 100, maximum is 10000.
- `offset` (Number) Number of records to skip before returning the response. Used for pagination. API default is 0.
- `prefix` (String) Filters by prefix.
- `project_key` (List of String) Filters by project key.
- `project_name` (List of String) Filters by project name.
- `result` (List of String) Filters by result. Allowed values: success, failure, warning.
- `sort` (String) Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. API default is 'desc'.
- `sort_by` (String) Field by which to sort results. Allowed values: timestamp, event_id, subject_type, subject_name, event_type, event_category, project_key, created_by. API default is 'timestamp'.
- `subject_id` (String) Filters by subject id.
- `subject_name` (String) Filters by subject name.
- `subject_type` (List of String) Filters by subject type.
- `timestamp_from` (Number) Filters by timestamp from (UNIX timestamp, milliseconds).
- `timestamp_to` (Number) Filters by timestamp to (UNIX timestamp, milliseconds).

### Read-Only

- `activity_logs` (Attributes List) List of activity log entries matching the query. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--activity_logs))
- `total` (Number) Total number of activity logs matching the query.

<a id="nestedatt--activity_logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `activity_logs`

Read-Only:

- `additional_data` (String) Additional structured data related to the event, as a raw JSON string.
- `application_key` (String) The key of the associated application, if applicable.
- `application_name` (String) The display name of the associated application.
- `created_by` (String) The user who initiated the event.
- `event_category` (String) The event category.
- `event_description` (String) The event description.
- `event_id` (String) The unique identifier for the activity log entry.
- `event_type` (String) The event type.
- `project_key` (String) The key of the associated project.
- `project_name` (String) The display name of the associated project.
- `result` (String) The result of the event (success, failure, warning).
- `subject_id` (String) The ID of the subject that triggered the event.
- `subject_name` (String) The name of the subject that triggered the event.
- `subject_type` (String) The type of subject that triggered the event.
- `timestamp` (Number) The UNIX timestamp (milliseconds) when the event occurred.
